interface.longDescription: Create sticker artwork from a creative brief and an optional attached reference. Open the workspace beside chat, compare results and download images. AI output may change fine details; inspect likeness, lettering and edges before use. A connected Firemoon account is required.
defaultPrompt: Create a cheerful orange cat sticker holding a coffee cup, then compare a blue-cup variation in the workspace.
Create sticker artwork from my attached image and help me refine the outline.

publication.release_notes: Updated publisher information and Imagineers website, support and policy links. Refreshed the app logo.

positive.description: Create one square illustration from a brief; verify the returned artwork loads in the side panel.
positive.prompt: Make a cheerful orange cat sticker holding a coffee cup, cream outline, no lettering.
positive.expected_behavior: Use aspect_ratio 1:1 and the user brief. Return one actual image with imageUrl and downloadUrl; show it in the workspace without claiming transparency or a cut path.

positive.description: Reference-image editing with a reviewer-accessible sample.
positive.prompt: Keep this cat design, but change its blue coffee cup to a mint-green teacup.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the actual supplied image source and the requested edit brief. Return a new actual image in the workspace; do not invent attachment IDs.

positive.description: Supported wide composition, distinct from square output.
positive.prompt: Make a wide sticker illustration of a fox beside a tree, simple orange and cream shapes, no lettering.
positive.expected_behavior: Use aspect_ratio 16:9. Return actual wide artwork and display it in the workspace with Open and Download controls.

positive.description: Recover existing artwork without a second generation.
positive.prompt: Show this existing cat artwork in the workspace so I can inspect it; do not generate a new image. https://jxzwlpbdjhikca2p.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/generated-image-1791054623312-0.png
positive.expected_behavior: Use the actual supplied image_url. Show the saved image; do not invoke sticker_studio_generate or claim a new image was generated.

positive.description: Refine and compare in the persistent workspace; sample reference included.
positive.prompt: Use this cat artwork as the first version. Help me make a green-cup variation and compare the two in the workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the real reference, then create only the requested variation. The workspace allows refinement, comparison, Download and Use in chat. Never automatically retry an uncertain generation.

negative.description: Video conversion is unsupported; explain the limit and do not invoke generation for video.
negative.prompt: Turn my attached MP4 into an animated sticker video.

negative.description: Vector tracing and printer cut paths are unsupported; explain and do not claim SVG/DXF export or invoke image generation as an equivalent.
negative.prompt: Trace this image into an editable SVG with an exact die-cut path for my cutter.

negative.description: Printing, shipping and purchases are unsupported; do not invoke media tools or claim an order.
negative.prompt: Print 200 copies of this sticker and ship them to my customers.
